About the Master's in Computer Science at TROY
Push the boundaries of technological innovation in Troy University's Master of Science
                  in Computer Science program. Here, you'll learn how to design, develop and implement
                  complex systems, gaining both technical skills and a deep understanding of theory
                  that allows you to work on everything from AI and data science, bioinformatics, cyber
                  security and cloud applications to video game programs. If you're interested in advanced-level
                  careers in computer science or graduate study, TROY's master's in computer science
                  program offers the intensive education and experience you need to achieve your goals.

Advanced Study With Real-World Practice
At TROY, you'll engage in hands-on individual and team projects that simulate real-world
                     scenarios, providing you with the experience you need to excel in the workplace. Working
                     with the latest technologies and tools in the field, you'll develop expertise in key
                     areas of computer science, such as artificial intelligence, software development,
                     data analysis, cyber security and system design. This experience, combined with the
computer science graduate program
's rigorous curriculum, prepares you to leverage theory and applications to advance
                     your career and stand at the forefront of technology.

computer science graduate program

Computer Science Graduate Program Concentrations
Tailor your master's in computer science to your career goals in one of the industry's
               top areas.
Artificial Intelligence
Artificial intelligence pushes the limits of computer science by analyzing, designing
                        and implementing self-learning and automatic machines. In the AI concentration, you'll
                        be part of this groundbreaking field, working on projects that focus on data-driven
                        system development, game design, data gathering and cleaning, knowledge representation,
                        and logic and reasoning.
By pursuing a
master of computer science
in AI at Troy University, you'll be prepared to excel in a variety of roles at the
                     forefront of technological advancement. With expertise in AI, you can pursue careers
                     as an AI researcher, data scientist, machine learning engineer, AI software developer
                     or AI consultant. Additionally, you'll be equipped to contribute to industries such
                     as health care, finance, gaming, robotics and automation, where the applications of
                     AI are rapidly expanding. Prepare yourself for a world of opportunities and make a
                     significant impact in the exciting field of artificial intelligence.
Non-Thesis Available: Online and Troy Campus
Thesis Available: Troy Campus

Bioinformatics
Bioinformatics combines computer science, biology and statistics to analyze and interpret
                        biological data and understand the complexity of living organisms. In this concentration,
                        you will learn how to develop algorithms and software tools for analyzing biological
                        data and gain the skills needed to pursue a career in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals
                        or academia.
The bioinformatics emphasis also includes projects focusing on protein sequence analysis,
                     data gathering and preparation, health condition, and disease prediction and health
                     data analysis. After completing the program, you'll be prepared to work in a wide
                     variety of bioinformatics and
computer science careers
, including bioinformatics scientist, bioinformatics engineer, health care software
                     developer and health care data analyst.
Non-Thesis Available: Troy Campus
Thesis Available: Troy Campus

Cloud and Big Data Concentration
In the cloud and big data concentration, you will delve into the cutting-edge technologies
                        of cloud computing and big data analytics. Gain expertise in designing and implementing
                        scalable and efficient cloud-based solutions to handle large volumes of data. Explore
                        advanced techniques for data storage, retrieval and analysis, and learn how to extract
                        meaningful insights from massive datasets.
Through hands-on projects and coursework in this
master's in computer science
concentration, you will develop proficiency in cloud platforms, distributed systems,
                        data management and data mining. Upon graduation, you will be well-equipped to pursue
                        roles such as cloud architect, big data engineer, cloud consultant and data analyst.
                        Join the forefront of technological innovation and make a significant impact in the
                        world of cloud computing and big data analysis.
Non-Thesis Available: Troy Campus
Thesis Available: Troy Campus

Computer Network and Security
The computer network and security concentration focuses on using computer science
                        skills to analyze, design and implement policies and practices to prevent and monitor
                        unauthorized access, misuse, modification or denial of computer resources.
In this
master's in computer science
concentration, you'll work on projects that focus on building modern cipher systems,
                        intrusion detection systems, data-driven security systems and building secure computer
                        networks.
This concentration prepares you to work in
computer science careers
such as network security engineer, security architect, security administrator, system
                     administrator, network administrator and network consultant.
Non-Thesis Available: Online and Troy Campus
Thesis Available: Troy Campus
Degree Map
Cyber Security
The cyber security concentration of the
computer science master's
program equips you with skills in analyzing, designing and implementing policies
                        and practices that prevent and monitor unauthorized access, misuse, modification or
                        denial of computer resources. Within this concentration, you will have the opportunity
                        to engage in hands-on projects that focus on various aspects of cyber security, including
                        security auditing, the development of adversarial and defense networks, and secure
                        software development. These practical experiences will enable you to apply your knowledge
                        and skills in real-world scenarios, further enhancing your understanding of the field.
Graduates of this program can pursue diverse professional pathways, such as penetration
                        testing, where you assess and identify vulnerabilities in systems and networks, cyber
                        security auditing, where you evaluate and ensure compliance with security standards,
                        cyber security engineering, where you design and implement robust security measures,
                        and cyber security analysis, where you analyze and respond to security incidents and
                        threats.
Non-Thesis Available: Online and Troy Campus
Thesis Available: Troy Campus

Data Science Concentration
This
computer science graduate program
concentration
offers a comprehensive curriculum that combines mathematics, statistics, and computer
                        science to extract valuable insights from data. In this program, you will develop
                        the skills necessary to analyze complex datasets, build predictive models, and make
                        data-driven decisions.
Through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical applications, you will
                        learn statistical methods, data mining techniques, machine learning algorithms and
                        data visualization tools. Gain hands-on experience working with real-world datasets
                        and tackle challenging problems in various domains, including business, health care,
                        finance and social sciences.
By mastering the techniques of data science, you will be prepared for diverse career
                        opportunities as a data scientist, data analyst, machine learning engineer, business
                        intelligence analyst or data engineer. Join the rapidly expanding field of data science
                        and become a valuable asset in transforming raw data into meaningful insights for
                        informed decision-making.

Video Game Design
Focused on the design of interactive games with immersive visuals and reality simulations,
                     this area continues to push the limits of computer science by combining new technologies
                     like cloud computing, 5G, AR/VR with traditional technologies like graphic art and
                     design.
In the video game design concentration of the master's in computer science program,
                     you'll have the opportunity to work on projects that focus on AI-driven system development,
                     game design, graphic design, knowledge representation, logic and reasoning and more.
                     You'll learn to create graphics and animation, develop video games and apply AI approaches
                     to create video game logic. You will also learn other skills such as brainstorming,
                     planning and management of video game projects, all while being exposed to different
                     video game development platforms.

Master of Computer Science FAQ
Learn more about the computer science graduate program.
Does TROY offer a master's in computer science program online?
Yes, Troy offers the computer science master's program both online and in person.
                     You can complete the m
aster's in computer science online
if you prefer flexibility and online learning.
What computer science careers are available after completing the program?
Our computer science graduates will have skills ready to work globally in a wide range
                     of workplaces as data scientists, software engineers, testers, system analysts, video
                     game designers, bioinformatics scientists, big data engineers, network engineers,
                     cyber security professionals in diverse computing, health care and business industries
                     as well as in government organizations and academia. TROY's computer science department
                     accommodates the Computer Science Career Fair that regularly hosts diverse employers
                     providing opportunities.
What is the job outlook for the computer science field?
The job outlook is continuously bright for all computer and information technology
                     positions as the industry continues to grow. Refer to the
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
for the most recent data.
What research areas does the TROY computer science department offer?
The department has faculty with diverse research specialties in a variety of areas,
                     including machine learning, data mining, bioinformatics, computer graphics, computer
                     vision, image processing, data science, big data, cloud computing, computer networks,
                     cyber security, automatic trading, pattern recognition, mobile data management and
                     business/education information technology.
Can I speak with a faculty member or current student about the program?
Yes!
Contact the computer science department
to schedule a meeting with a faculty member or current student.
